name: 黄油厚涂镜面水光唇釉款
description: 旋涡厚涂抹痕、勾选卖点、色号墙与手臂色阶试色分镜齐全

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF for packshots, pearl grey #F0EFEC for texture and detail screens, one flat lavender #8C84B4 editorial field; tinted band columns only inside the shade wall
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft beauty light, front-left key with a large bounce, sweeping wet highlights on gloss surfaces, skimming light only for texture detail, soft contact shadows, never harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy ripple white field and matte pearl panel #F0EFEC, warm paper #F7F6F4 for document screens
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, short label lines in charcoal #1B1B1D, generous letter spacing, never mixed with script or serif
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line square tick boxes and blank number chips, single accent colour, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: same slim upright tube scale and same straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle across the set, thick gel swirl always sculpted with visible ridges, no colour cast drift between shots
noDrift: no shade numbers or efficacy claims invented
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium glossy lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, pearl grey #F0EFEC, one lavender accent #8C84B4 and charcoal text #1B1B1D; neutral-cool bright soft beauty lighting with a front-left key, sweeping wet highlights on gloss and skimming light only on texture details, soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with short label lines; thin-line square tick boxes and blank number chips as the only icon language; stable slim upright tube scale and a straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.displayName: 白底厚乳唇釉立管主图
shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净直立的细管剪影抢位并满足平台主图规范
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, capped tube standing dead upright and centered, full silhouette inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: even white margin all round, no copy placed
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One slim transparent tube standing dead upright and capped, centered in frame, photographed straight-on at eye level with the full silhouette visible and nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even white margin all round and no text placed anywhere. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no gel swirl or smear marks, no background tint, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.displayName: 旋涡厚涂抹痕质地主图
shots.intent: 一秒传达厚乳凝霜质地这一核心卖点，用超大旋涡抹痕做视觉主张
shots.camera: straight-on with a very slight low angle so both units read tall, uncapped tube beside its upright wand
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the upper left with a broad bounce, sweeping highlight travelling along the wet curves, gentle contact shadows
shots.background: pearl grey field #F0EFEC carrying one oversized sculpted gel swirl
shots.props: one oversized thick swirl of clear gel spread behind the two units
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the top right, no copy placed
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}: the uncapped tube standing beside its upright applicator wand while one oversized thick swirl of clear gel gloss is sculpted into a soft ribbon behind them. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on with a very slight low angle so both units read tall, full products visible. Soft directional key light from the upper left with a broad bounce, a sweeping highlight travelling along the wet curves of the swirl, gentle contact shadows under both bases. Pearl grey field #F0EFEC with the swirl catching the same tone. The group occupies 50-60% of the frame, clean negative space across the top right and no text placed there. Negative: no plastic-looking gel, no dust or bubbles trapped in the swirl, no dripping mess, no hands, no extra props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 把三条质地主张收进勾选清单里，一次浏览完成卖点沟通
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at eye level, capped tube left of centre beside its wand
shots.lighting: soft frontal key with wide sweep of highlight across the rippled surface, shallow contact shadows
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF over a low-relief milky ripple field
shots.props: three thin-line empty square tick boxes stacked on the upper left
shots.whitespace: left column reserved for the label list, open space along the top edge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit checklist hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The capped tube standing left of centre at a slight 3/4 angle beside its upright wand, resting on a low-relief milky ripple surface that fills the frame. Soft frontal key light with a wide sweep of highlight across the ripples and shallow contact shadows. Background pure white #FFFFFF over the ripple field. Three thin-line empty square tick boxes stacked on the upper left, each followed by one short label reading 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 in charcoal #1B1B1D. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, left column reserved for the label list, open space along the top edge. Negative: no more than three labels, no dense body text, no fabricated claims or test results implied by the ticks, no handwriting style type, no watermark, no fake logo, no text beyond the listed placeholders.

shots.intent: 用一处纯色编辑感场景让买家代入上唇后的镜面效果
shots.camera: straight-on close crop of the lower two-thirds of a generic model's face at eye level, tube held up beside the cheek
shots.lighting: soft frontal beauty light with a large overhead diffusion panel, one clean specular streak across the lips, 5600K
shots.props: the model's own hand holding the tube, no other props
shots.whitespace: open space at the right edge beyond the face, no copy placed
shots.promptTemplate: Beauty editorial scene: a generic model with no resemblance to any real person holds {product} beside her cheek, fingertips resting on the cap, lips and jawline carrying the same wet mirror finish. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level as a close crop of the lower two-thirds of the face, shallow depth of field. Soft frontal beauty light with a large overhead diffusion panel, one clean specular streak across the lips, 5600K. Flat lavender background #8C84B4. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with open space at the right edge and no text placed there. Negative: no celebrity likeness, no plastic over-smoothed skin, keep pores and fine lines visible, no deformed hands or extra fingers, no second product, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 用一镜微距证明膏体浓稠挂得住，消除对稀薄流挂的疑虑
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down along the wand shaft, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming light from the left revealing viscosity ridges, one controlled specular line, no hotspot
shots.background: pearl grey panel #F0EFEC falling soft behind the tip
shots.whitespace: tight crop, minimal margin because the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the flocked doe-foot applicator drawn from {product}, a single heavy bead of clear gloss hanging at its tip, tight zoom on the bead. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down along the wand shaft, macro lens, shallow depth of field with the tip sharp and the tube soft behind it. Skimming light from the left that reveals the viscosity ridges inside the bead, one controlled specular line and no harsh hotspot. Pearl grey background #F0EFEC. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with a tight crop and minimal margin. Negative: no blurry subject, no stringing or broken gel tail, no dust or fingerprints on the tube, no extra props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 同一件产品在三种肤色上的镜面效果并置，替买家预判上嘴结果
shots.camera: matched straight-on frontal close crops of the lower face, identical distance and crop in every wear tile, plus one top-down tile
shots.lighting: even soft frontal beauty light identical in all tiles, one specular streak per lip surface, 5600K
shots.background: neutral white tiling field #FFFFFF with the product tile on pearl grey #F0EFEC
shots.props: one tube with a thick swirl smear in the product tile only
shots.whitespace: hairline gutters between tiles, no copy placed
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison grid of four matched tiles: three tiles each a straight-on close crop of the lower face of a different generic model wearing {product}, identical distance, crop and camera height in every wear tile, plus one tile showing the tube with a thick sculpted swirl smear laid flat. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft frontal beauty light identical across all four tiles, one clean specular streak per lip surface, 5600K, visible pores and skin texture kept intact with no retouching look. Wear tiles sit on a neutral white field #FFFFFF and the product tile on pearl grey #F0EFEC. The faces and product together occupy 50-60% of the frame with hairline gutters between tiles and no text placed. Negative: no repeated identical faces, no deformed teeth or gums, no exaggerated results, no fabricated claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 一面色号墙让买家挑色并感知系列纵深，抬组合购买意愿
shots.camera: straight-on flat wall view at eye level, every tube the same size and spacing with no perspective drift
shots.lighting: even high-key lighting, identical shadow under every tube, no specular mismatch between columns
shots.background: neutral panel field #EFEDEA built as tinted vertical band columns graduating pale to deep, one accent band in lavender #8C84B4
shots.props: blank number chips floating above each tube
shots.whitespace: thin margins top and bottom, tight even rhythm across the row
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant shade wall: a long row of identical slim tubes of {product} stood upright in a line, each on its own tinted vertical band, the bands graduating from pale to deep with a couple of shimmer panels, blank number chips floating above each tube. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on as a flat wall at eye level so every tube keeps the same size and spacing with no perspective drift. Even high-key lighting with an identical shadow under every tube and no specular mismatch. Neutral panel field #EFEDEA behind the bands, with one accent band in lavender #8C84B4 reserved for the highlighted shade. The row occupies 70-80% of the frame overall with thin margins top and bottom. The top strip carries one short title reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in charcoal #1B1B1D. Negative: no invented shade counts or shade names, no duplicate tubes with mismatched lighting, no mixed fonts, no watermark, no fake logo, no text beyond the listed placeholder.

shots.intent: 把色阶按深浅排到真实皮肤上，帮买家在自然光感下完成选色
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle down three forearms laid side by side
shots.lighting: hard directional light from the left, crisp narrow shadows cast to the right of each arm, wet specular highlights inside every stripe
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF wall and surface under the arms
shots.props: one slim tube resting at the top edge of the frame
shots.whitespace: clean margin along the top for the legend column
shots.textZone: upper-right legend column of short label lines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce swatch screen: three forearms of different skin tones laid side by side on a seamless white surface, each carrying a vertical ladder of glossy colour stripes in the same order, one slim tube resting at the top edge of the frame and a matching column of blank label lines in the upper right corner. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. Hard directional light from the left casting crisp narrow shadows to the right of each arm, wet specular highlights inside every stripe. Background seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The arms and stripes occupy 55-60% of the frame with a clean margin along the top for the legend. The legend column carries short lines reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 in charcoal #1B1B1D. Negative: no invented shade names or numbers, no duplicate or mirrored arm, no deformed hands or extra fingers, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no text beyond the listed placeholders.

shots.intent: 收口一页信息型版面承接详情疑虑，以空参数位承接真实资质素材
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level document layout, tube stood at the left edge
shots.lighting: flat even high-key light with a soft contact shadow under the tube, no dramatic falloff
shots.background: warm paper field #F7F6F4 with thin rule lines
shots.props: empty parameter rows and one blank seal outline
shots.whitespace: generous negative space filling the document column on the right
shots.textZone: right two-thirds document column, rows kept empty
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and specification screen: {product} stood at the left edge while the right two-thirds of the frame carries a quiet document layout, one short heading line, several empty parameter rows on thin rules and one blank seal outline, all drawn in charcoal #1B1B1D. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level with flat even high-key lighting and a soft contact shadow under the tube. Warm paper background #F7F6F4. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with generous negative space filling the document column. The parameter rows stay empty as proof placeholders and only the heading reads 「{callout_5}」. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, lab results, percentages, ingredient lists or test data, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable type, no QR codes, no watermark, no fake logo, no text beyond the listed placeholder.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：1 白底直立闭管细管；2 开盖管与直立绒毛刷头并立、身后一超大旋涡厚涂抹痕；3 白底乳白涟漪上直立管配左上方三条勾选清单字样；4 雾紫纯色背景模特持管近景、唇面镜面高光并带角标字样；5 编号色块柱上一整排同规格立管的全色号墙；6 与 8 四只与三只不同肤色手臂竖向排色阶试色条并配右上色号名称列表；7 整页成分文字墙。品类判定：图中为唇部着色产品（唇釉/唇蜜），上色与色阶选择是核心卖点，故 L1 取「美妆彩妆」、L2 取「唇部」，非护理类唇膜或唇部清洁工具。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、色号名与编号、四角营销角标字样、原勾选清单英文原句、整页成分文字（改为空参数行与空印章框）、模特面容身份（改为 generic model）；所有质地与使用主张一律用 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 空位承接，未写入任何断言或检测数据。
